data.name: v4.0.0
data.body:
## [4.0.0] - [2026-08]

### Removed
- Mode `--assemble`. Pipeline now accepts only FASTA file as main input, no reads support anymore.
- Mode `--onlyannotate`. Detection step has become mandatory.
- Flag `--use_proteins`. There is no need to specify that flag anymore. Proteins can be provided in input `--samplesheet`. If nothing was provided per record - pipeline will run protein prediction step.
- Argument `--fasta`. Input contigs should be provided only with `--samplesheet`.
- `FILTER_PROTEINS_IN_CONTIGS` step
- environment variable `CONTIGS` and `contig_number`
- viral identifier from proteins headers. Now only contigs have `|viral_sequence` or `|prophage` identifiers

### Replaced
- `Prodigal` replaced with `pyrodigal`

### Fixed
- Download databases process. Separated each database input.
- Changed protein-related steps to make protein-contig linkage from GFF file (ex. split_proteins, annotate, assign)
- Bug in `write_gff` not publishing all proteins related to viral/prophage record.
- Bug in `write_gff` not processing data if all inputs (quality, annotation and assignment) were not provided.

### Added
- `proteins_faa` and `proteins_gff` fields to input samplesheet. Now if user wants to provide already predicted proteins - those should be provided in `faa` **and** `gff` files.
- **Proteins compatibility** step: checks validity of protein files + tests.
- **Rename prodigal** step. Prodigal sometimes renamed proteins into `digit_digit` format in `ID=` field in GFF. Those records are renamed back to original protein name.
- **GitHub actions**: linting, pytest, nf-test for subworkflow
- **Docs**: development, output and usage. Simplified README, changed pipeline schema, added schema `.svg`
- More unit tests
- `requrements.txt`

## New Contributors
* @Ge94 made their first contribution in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/177

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/compare/v3.3.2...v4.0.0

## What's Changed
* chunk virfinder by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/174
* Update database paths and a few configs by @Ge94 in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/177
* Add proteins gff as pipeline input by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/172
* fix rename missing output by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/180
* Remove assembling by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/181
* Fix/GitHub actions by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/185
* Tests for protein subworkflows by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/184
* Fix/remove --use_proteins by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/182
* Remove not-determined filter by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/187
* Don't rename the taxonomy results -- also remove failOnError on publish by @mberacochea in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/188
* 4.0.0 release  by @KateSakharova in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/179
* checkpoints for no cds sequences by @Ales-ibt in https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/emg-viral-pipeline/pull/189
